subject: 38 Pearl Street Demolition Delay
overview: The commission held a special meeting to lift a demolition delay for a residential property and reviewed administrative correspondence regarding a public plaza project.

items.title: 38 Pearl Street Demolition Delay
items.summary: Approved lifting the demolition delay for a partial demolition and addition after the applicant revised the massing and fenestration to maintain the integrity of the original house.

items.title: Riverside Plaza Design Review
items.summary: Reviewed a draft letter of approval for the Riverside Avenue Plaza design and coordinated final edits on the document.
